name: Matt Ramsey

bio: Matt serves as Chief Engineer (CHENG), the technical and editorial control point for MH Construction's construction systems, public digital infrastructure, brand governance, website development, and release readiness. His assigned responsibilities in marketing, safety, and project support connect field reality, operational controls, stakeholder communication, and public trust under one accountable standard. A U.S. Navy veteran and Arizona State University Operations Management graduate, he brings mission focus, technical discipline, and service-minded accountability to every release.

Maintains brand standards and factual consistency across MH public channels.

Builds durable website and operational systems that support decision readiness.
funFact: Matt brings the same disciplined mindset from military service and coaching into digital and safety execution.
